slice.leaf: public Git pinned text artifact as a zero-execution integrity/provenance substrate
slice.question: Can scheduled Chat read a public text artifact while obtaining exact repository commit and blob identities using only lightweight repository transport, with hosted runner, Actions, Codespaces, LFS/package/artifact storage, external verifier, finite monthly/trial/paid quota and manual user execution all held at zero?

public_probe.content_observed: README text was returned in the Chat repository surface when pinned to the exact commit.

replaces_or_reduces: richer-mode execution for reading small public text artifacts
external hashing/version lookup for repository-native identity metadata
ambiguous latest-state references by pinning evidence to an exact commit
some duplicate/stale-evidence risk by persisting exact commit/blob handles

candidate_comparison.conflict_duplication_risk: low when exact commit/blob handles are persisted; branch-head-only references remain mutable
candidate_comparison.quota_fragility: low for the accepted mechanism because no optional hosted compute/storage quota is required; ordinary repository API rate limiting remains a cross-invocation transport concern

scope_limits: Tested one public repository text file only.
The GitHub/connector transport is the trust anchor; provider-independent cryptographic authenticity was not established.
The Git object hash was not independently recomputed from raw bytes in this slice.
No branch protection, signed commit/tag, force-push resistance, availability SLA, private-repository access, binary artifact, LFS, package, Actions or hosted compute behavior was tested.
Freshness is only the observed ref state at probe time; a later moving branch head requires a new ref read.

conflict_check: Semantic inputs were current sanitized controls, own role-local state and the public github/docs repository only. No O/O-derived, other-worker, downstream, legacy, aggregate-ledger or protected-primary semantics were consumed; no scheduler mutation occurred.
frontier: Test whether exact Git commit/tree/parent metadata can provide a text-native append-only checkpoint lineage for freshness, replay and duplicate/conflict detection using only lightweight repository transport and zero optional monthly quota.
Preserve the pinned-text identity mechanism as a provider-anchored partial transversal solution; do not broaden it to provider-independent authenticity.
Keep branch-force-push resistance, signed provenance and provider-independent verification unresolved unless separately tested.
exact_continuation: Fresh-bootstrap the latest instruction manifest, RUN_LIFECYCLE, DESIRED_STATE and cross_field role config; reconstruct r225 from LATEST. Execute exactly one bounded Phase-1 leaf: test whether public Git commit metadata (commit SHA, tree SHA and parent SHA) gives scheduled Chat a text-native append-only checkpoint lineage sufficient for replay and duplicate/stale-conflict detection without Actions, hosted runner, Codespaces, artifacts/LFS/packages, external verifier, finite monthly/trial/paid quota, incremental cost or manual user execution. Use only role-local clean state plus public sources, record force-push/provider-trust limits, then checkpoint/read back a nonempty next frontier.
